source.modifications: Supplied sounding pitches retained; repeats expanded; explicit ties joined. Overlapping same-pitch voices coalesced into one sustain (audit lists suppressed inner attacks). Ornament realizations omitted; no implied ties added. Quarter=56 and voice velocities are editorial. Source PDF could not be independently inspected in this execution environment.
source.pitch: C major; standard E2 A2 D3 G3 B3 E4. Algorithmic string assignment, frets0-12 allowed, no simultaneous string collision and nonzero fret spread<=6. Finger numbers, shifts, barres and human playability unverified. Original voice tokens retained separately.
source.terms: Arrangement and derived score CC BY-SA 3.0: retain composer/arranger/source/license/change notices; share adaptations alike. No endorsement implied. Application code and existing two-voice arrangement are separate.
